phases.10: LEFT leg absorbs landing: LEFT foot planted moving backward a little, left knee bends deeply; RIGHT leg folds behind with heel up. Head/pelvis lower 1.5 percent image height. RIGHT talisman forearm forward begins descending, LEFT bell forearm behind bends inward. Opposite legs to E02.
phases.11: LEFT foot supports under pelvis with flexed knee, body passes over it. RIGHT thigh swings forward with heel tucked and shoe well above floor. Head/pelvis remain low but start rising. RIGHT talisman hand passes downward near waist toward rear, LEFT bell hand passes near waist toward front. Elbows remain bent.
phases.12: LEFT foot pushes backward strongly on its toe, heel lifted while toe still touches floor. RIGHT knee drives forward with right foot airborne. Pelvis rises toward neutral. LEFT bell arm advances forward, RIGHT talisman arm swings behind. Right near leg forward, far left leg extends back.
phases.13: SECOND flight rising: BOTH feet clear floor. LEFT leg extends back after toe-off then starts folding; RIGHT thigh forward with bent knee and lower leg starting to open. Pelvis/head 2 percent image height above landing. LEFT bell arm front, RIGHT talisman arm back. Same handedness and identity.
phases.14: SECOND flight apex: RIGHT thigh forward knee bent, LEFT knee folded behind with heel toward rump; both soles about 5 percent image height above floor. Head/pelvis 3 percent image height above landing. LEFT bell arm strongest forward pump, RIGHT talisman arm back. Different leg silhouette than first flight apex.
phases.15: SECOND flight descent: RIGHT lower leg unfolds forward preparing landing; LEFT leg trails bent. BOTH soles above floor, right sole about 3 percent image height above it. Head/pelvis descend to 1.5 percent above landing. LEFT bell arm forward, RIGHT talisman arm behind; eyes/face/size identical.
phases.16: RIGHT pre-contact late descent: RIGHT forefoot reaches down forward, right sole 1 percent image height ABOVE floor, knee slightly bent; LEFT foot lifted behind. Head/pelvis just above neutral landing. LEFT bell arm forward begins reversing and RIGHT talisman arm behind begins reversing. This should transition naturally into reference E01 right landing; pose must be close to but distinct from E01.
phases.01: Right contact, left bell arm forward and right talisman arm back.
phases.02: RIGHT leg absorbs landing: right foot stays planted at the SAME floor height, travels backward a little in the running-in-place cycle; right knee bends deeply, pelvis and head lower 1.5 percent of image height. LEFT leg folds behind with left heel up. RIGHT talisman forearm remains behind but bends inward; LEFT bell forearm remains forward and begins moving down. A clear compressed running pose, not a walk.
phases.03: RIGHT foot supports under the pelvis, knee bent, body passing over support. LEFT thigh swings forward with heel tucked below buttock, shoe still well above floor. Head/pelvis remain low but start rising. BOTH elbows bent about 90 degrees; RIGHT talisman arm passes close to waist moving forward, LEFT bell arm passes down close to waist moving backward. Keep hand objects separate from torso.
phases.04: RIGHT foot pushes backward strongly on its toe; RIGHT ankle extends and the heel rises, toe still touches the invisible floor. LEFT knee swings forward with the left foot lifted. Pelvis rises toward neutral height. RIGHT talisman arm advances in front of chest, LEFT bell arm swings behind. Torso leans forward, bent elbows and short chibi limbs.
phases.05: FIRST flight rising: BOTH feet visibly clear of the invisible floor. RIGHT leg extends back after toe-off then starts folding; LEFT thigh reaches forward, left knee bent and lower leg beginning to open. Pelvis/head 2 percent image height above landing height. RIGHT talisman arm front, LEFT bell arm back; wrists stay connected. Do not depict a jump with both knees together.
phases.06: FIRST flight apex: LEFT thigh forward with knee bent, RIGHT knee folds behind so heel rises toward rump; both feet around 5 percent image height above floor. Head/pelvis 3 percent image height above landing. RIGHT talisman arm forward at strongest natural pump, LEFT bell arm backward; both elbows bent. Two legs must show different readable silhouettes.
phases.07: FIRST flight descent: LEFT lower leg unfolds forward preparing landing while RIGHT trailing leg stays folded. Both feet are clear of the floor, left sole about 3 percent image height above it. Pelvis/head descend to 1.5 percent above landing. RIGHT talisman arm forward, LEFT bell arm back. No support contact yet.
phases.08: LEFT pre-contact late descent: LEFT forefoot reaching down forward about 1 percent image height ABOVE floor, left knee slightly bent; RIGHT foot lifted behind. Pelvis/head just above neutral landing height. RIGHT talisman arm remains forward but begins reversing, LEFT bell arm behind begins reversing. Next frame is LEFT landing.
phases.09: LEFT foot lands forward with slightly bent knee; RIGHT leg trails bent and lifted behind. Pelvis at neutral landing height. RIGHT talisman arm swings FORWARD, LEFT bell arm swings BACKWARD. This is the opposite-leg contact to reference E01, NOT a mirrored identity, props MUST NOT switch hands. Near right knee/leg visibly trails, far left shoe contacts ground forward. Both elbows bent.
